info.name: Study Helper API v2
info.description:
# **Overview:

**The Study Helper API is a comprehensive platform aimed at assisting students with their study  
session schedules, learning resources, and academic statistics. The API integrates multiple  
functionalities to help students plan, track, and optimize their study activities. This solution goes  
beyond basic CRUD operations by offering complex data aggregation, real-time data  
management, personalized recommendations, and dynamic scheduling.

### Real-World Relevance:

Many students struggle to organize their study schedules and obtain study resources. This  
API addresses the need for a comprehensive study assistant that combines planning,  
resource recommendations, reminders, and progress tracking. The system is scalable, and it’s  
applicable to college students in all academic fields.

##### The Study Helper API focuses on:

● Setting exam date reminders.  
● Allowing personalized scheduling, progress tracking, and study reminders.  
● Offering external resources for subjects like online articles, researches, and  
helpful links.  
● Allowing users to share study resources (notes).

External APIs used:

- CORE API for study resources
    
- Google API
    
    - Google Calendar for marking exam datetimes
        
    - Gmail for sending notes
        
- Zen Quotes API for motivational quotes
    
- Open Trivia Database API for quiz resources

item.name: Auth
item.description: Register or log in first: both save the tokens into collection variables automatically. Every other request uses `Bearer {{access_token}}` (set on the collection). Access tokens last 1 hour; run "Refresh access token" to get a new one.

item.name: /tasks
item.description:
CRUD tasks for studying.

Request Parameters:

- Required:
    
    - `task` (string): The study task description.
        
    - `goal_date` (date, format: YYYY-MM-DD): The target completion date for the task.
        
- Optional:
    
    - `status` (boolean): Task completion status (default: false).
        

Request Body Example (POST/PUT):  
{  
"task": "Complete Python assignment",  
"goal_date": "2023-12-01",  
"status": false  
}

Response Structure (GET/POST/PUT):  
{  
"id": 1,  
"task": "Complete Python assignment",  
"status": false,  
"goal_date": "2023-12-01",  
"created_at": "2023-11-01T10:00:00Z"  
}

Error Handling:

- 400 Bad Request: Invalid request body or missing required fields.
    
- 404 Not Found: Task not found for GET/PUT/DELETE requests.

item.name: /subjects-lessons
item.description:
CRUD lessons under respective subjects.

Request Parameters:

    - `subject` (string): The name of the subject.
        
    - `lesson` (string): The lesson content.
        

Request Body Example (POST/PUT):

"subject": "Mathematics",

}

Error Handling:

- 400 Bad Request: Missing required fields.
    
- 404 Not Found: Lesson not found for GET/PUT/DELETE requests.

item.name: /study-schedule
item.description:
CRUD a subject they want to study with x number of hours and date to be studied.

Request Parameters:

- Required:
    
    - `study_date` (date, format: YYYY-MM-DD): The study session date.
        
    - `study_hours` (float): Total study hours planned.
        
    - `subjects` (string): Comma-separated list of subjects.
        

Request Body Example (POST/PUT):  
{  
"study_date": "2023-12-01",  
"study_hours": 5.5,  
"subjects": "Mathematics,Physics"  
}

Response Structure (GET/POST/PUT):  
{  
"id": 1,  
"study_date": "2023-12-01",  
"study_hours": 5.5,  
"subjects": "Mathematics,Physics",  
"created_at": "2023-11-01T10:00:00Z"  
}

Error Handling:

- 400 Bad Request: Missing required fields or invalid data types.
    
- 404 Not Found: Study schedule not found for GET/PUT/DELETE requests.

item.name: /study-resources
item.description:
CRUD own study resources.

Request Parameters:

- Required:
    
    - `title` (string): Title of the resource.
        
    - `url` (string): URL of the resource.
        
    - `subject` (string): Subject associated with the resource.
        
    - `resource_type` (string): Type of resource (e.g., book, article).
        

Request Body Example (POST/PUT):  
{  
"title": "Python Crash Course",  
"url": "[https://example.com/python-crash-course"](https://example.com/python-crash-course),  
"subject": "Programming",  
"resource_type": "book"  
}

Response Structure (GET/POST/PUT):  
{  
"id": 1,  
"title": "Python Crash Course",  
"url": "[https://example.com/python-crash-course"](https://example.com/python-crash-course),  
"subject": "Programming",  
"resource_type": "book",  
"created_at": "2023-11-01T10:00:00Z"  
}

Error Handling:

- 400 Bad Request: Missing required fields.
    
- 404 Not Found: Study resource not found for GET/PUT/DELETE requests.

item.name: /study-break

Request Parameters:

    - `break_duration` (integer): Break duration in minutes.
        

Request Body Example (POST/PUT):

"break_duration": 10

Response Structure (GET/POST/PUT):  
{  
"id": 1,  
"study_duration": 50,

"created_at": "2023-11-01T10:00:00Z"

Error Handling:

- 400 Bad Request: Missing required fields.
    
- 404 Not Found: Study break timer not found for GET/PUT/DELETE requests.

request.description:
Fetches /study-schedule and /study-break to generate a study schedule limited by available hours and makes intervals based on study break timer chosen. Accounts for lunch and dinner time by allotting an hour for each.

Request Parameters:

- Required:
    
    - `study_schedule_id` (integer): ID of the study schedule.
        
    - `timer_id` (integer): ID of the study break timer.
        

Response Structure:  
{  
"message": "Detailed study schedule generated successfully.",  
"schedule": \[  
{  
"subject": "Mathematics",  
"type": "study",  
"start_time": "08:00",  
"end_time": "09:00",  
"duration_minutes": 60  
},  
{  
"subject": "Mathematics",  
"type": "break",  
"start_time": "09:00",  
"end_time": "09:10",  
"duration_minutes": 10  
}  
\]  
}

Error Handling:

- 400 Bad Request: Invalid study hours or no subjects available.
    
- 404 Not Found: Study schedule or timer not found.

Run Create in /study-schedule and /study-break first; their ids are saved automatically.
Random quote from ZenQuotes. 502 if ZenQuotes is unreachable.

Questions from Open Trivia DB. Supported subjects include math, science, computers, history, geography, art, music, sports, books. 400 for unsupported subjects; 502 if Open Trivia DB fails (it allows 1 request per 5 seconds).
Research works from CORE. Needs CORE_API_KEY in .env (503 if missing, 502 if CORE fails).

Returns `authorization_url`. Open it in a browser, sign in with a test-user Google account and allow access. Google then redirects to /api/oauth/callback/, which saves the connection. The link expires after 10 minutes.

item.name: Setup: create a note to send

request.description: Emails a note from your connected Gmail. Create a note first. 401 if Google is not connected, 404 if the note is not yours.
Creates an event on your primary Google Calendar in CALENDAR_TIME_ZONE. duration_minutes is optional (default 120). Returns the event link.
